R_GWAS_SIGNIFICANCE.title: GWAS significance threshold
R_GWAS_SIGNIFICANCE.directive: Do not upgrade suggestive or sub-threshold associations to strong exact-disease genetics.

R_GWAS_REPLICATION.title: Replication is required for robustness
R_GWAS_REPLICATION.directive: Treat missing independent replication as a reason to avoid robustness claims and increase uncertainty.

R_GWAS_TRAIT_ALIGNMENT.title: Related traits are not disease-matched evidence
R_GWAS_TRAIT_ALIGNMENT.directive: Do not treat related GWAS traits as exact-disease support without explicit disease-matched mapping.

R_GWAS_METADATA_UNCERTAINTY.title: Metadata gaps should raise uncertainty
R_GWAS_METADATA_UNCERTAINTY.directive: Missing replication, ancestry, or study metadata should raise uncertainty rather than confidence.

R_OT_RELATIVE_SCORE.title: Open Targets scores are relative
R_OT_RELATIVE_SCORE.directive: Interpret Open Targets scores as relative rankings, not stand-alone confidence or validation.

R_OT_CLINICAL_SCOPE.title: Clinical precedent must be disease-matched
R_OT_CLINICAL_SCOPE.directive: Do not treat adjacent-indication or indirect clinical activity as exact-disease approval or maturity.

R_OT_TRACTABILITY_PRECEDENCE.title: Predicted tractability is not clinical maturity
R_OT_TRACTABILITY_PRECEDENCE.directive: Predicted tractability alone does not establish clinical precedent, maturity, or validated drug evidence.

R_OT_SAFETY_CAUTION.title: Safety liabilities reduce prioritization optimism
R_OT_SAFETY_CAUTION.directive: Safety liabilities or essentiality concerns should reduce prioritization optimism rather than be ignored.
